content: Men of character are the conscience of the society to which they belong.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Laws and police forces cannot maintain civilization without women and men of incorruptible moral character who embody ethical truth by their daily presence.
practicalInsight: Act as a beacon of calm integrity in your workplace, especially when corner-cutting is normalized.
reflectionPrompt: How can your steadfast personal character elevate the moral tone of your environment?
